id_note: original ids are written as strings because uint64 ids exceed the exact range of JSON numbers

layout.raw: uint8 (z, y, x), gzip 4, chunked: EM intensity, source values untouched
layout.instance: smallest unsigned integer type (z, y, x), gzip 4, chunked: compact ids 0..K, 0 = background, 1 = largest instance (absent for image-only samples)
layout.instance_original_ids: uint64 (K+1,): original id of compact id i, entry 0 is 0
layout.instance_voxel_counts: uint32 (K+1,): voxels of compact id i inside the crop, entry 0 counts background
layout.instance_bbox_zyx: int32 (K+1, 6): z0, y0, x0, z1, y1, x1 in crop voxels, upper bounds exclusive; row 0 (background) is all zeros
